slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
fearless around anyone

joining a sports team

join a local team in a sport you're not good at. learning in front of others, and laughing at your own mistakes, slowly kills the fear of looking foolish.

hosting game nights

invite people over for a board game night once a month. being the host puts you at the centre of the room in the gentlest, most relaxed and natural way.

a daily lesson

spend 5 minutes a day learning something interesting: a lost city, a strange animal, a famous painter. having things to share makes talking to anyone feel easy.
slides.texte_sophia:
a daily lesson

i spend 5 minutes a day learning something interesting: a lost city, a strange animal. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and talking to anyone feels easy now.

slides.texte_overlay:
travelling alone

take a short trip on your own, even just for a weekend. finding your way in a new place alone builds a quiet confidence that nothing at home can ever give you.

taking an acting class

sign up for a beginner acting or improv class. performing in front of strangers on purpose makes ordinary everyday conversations feel wonderfully easy.
